scope: Independent loopback-only S3 lock-create probes; temporary files and receiver cleaned; no shared MinIO, cloud, SSH or Docker calls.
decision: Preserve STORAGE_TIMEOUT, retryability and outcome_ambiguous. Do not infer a definitive quota/auth code from generic HTTP403, message text or retry timing.
limits: Research concerns information preserved by this restic release, not a real provider quota exhaustion.
Structured SDK exceptions are handled independently; a later diagnostic request would not establish the earlier command outcome.
